acceptance.criterion: Findings must be reproducible from the current source
acceptance.evidence: All 4 findings have executable Python reproductions that were run and verified against the current source tree. Finding 1: assert not any RUN_FINISHED, assert in_progress == 1. Finding 2: assert validation_passed index < failed index. Finding 3: assert outputs == {'OUT.a.x': 1, 'OUT.b.x': 1}. Finding 4: assert pending == 1, cancelled == 1, completed == 1.

acceptance.criterion: Duplicate symptoms of one root cause count as one finding
acceptance.evidence: Findings 1 and 2 both involve multi-target result handling but have distinct root causes: Finding 1 is an uncaught ParseError at coordinator.py:202 outside the try/except; Finding 2 is premature VALIDATION_PASSED emission at coordinator.py:186 before target validation at coordinator.py:206. These are separate code paths with separate fixes.

acceptance.criterion: If fewer than three real defects exist, say so rather than padding the list
acceptance.evidence: 4 real defects found, all reproduced with executable scripts. No padding.

acceptance.criterion: Each severity must be justified by concrete impact
acceptance.evidence: Critical (Finding 1): run left without RUN_FINISHED event, task stuck in IN_PROGRESS, run ID permanently consumed. High (Finding 2): event log contains contradictory validation_passed then failed for same invocation. Medium (Finding 3): two distinct targets silently receive same value, handler keys ignored. Medium (Finding 4): pending tasks after terminal failure mislead status reporting.

acceptance.criterion: Do not edit src/, tests/, or this task file
acceptance.evidence: No production or test files were modified. All work written under demo/runs/runtime-review-glm52/.

acceptance.criterion: Do not count missing future language features as bugs
acceptance.evidence: The 'done' expression (parser.py:95-102) was investigated and classified as a future feature, not a bug. No finding was raised for it.

acceptance.criterion: Do not report speculative concurrency problems unless a current API permits the interleaving
acceptance.evidence: The TOCTOU gap in _current_state_version vs append_batch CAS check was investigated but not reported, because the current API is single-threaded with a single SQLite connection and no async handler dispatch.

protocol_deviations.deviation: Program name in program.think uses underscores (runtime_adversarial_review) instead of hyphens (runtime-adversarial-review) because the Thinklang parser _NAME regex [a-z][a-z0-9_]* does not allow hyphens in PROGRAM names. The run_id uses hyphens as assigned.
protocol_deviations.impact: None — the program name is internal to the sealed program and does not affect any artifact or acceptance check.
